text:
Alex Kim: Quick micro-sweep notes: L4 vs T4 vs A10G for embeddings + small-chat across us-west / eu-north / ap-south. Put compact runbook below.
Maria V: nice, can you share the p50/p95 and cost delta?
Alex Kim: Short summary first: A10G wins raw latency (p50 ~24ms chat, p95 ~80ms), L4 wins cost-per-throughput for embeddings at higher batch sizes, T4 is cheapest single-card option for small-chat at low concurrency but higher tail risk.
Cheng Wu: do you have concrete numbers from the runs?
Alex Kim: Yes — pasted quick table (tokens/sec and cost normalized to A10G=1.0):
```
workload    gpu   p50_ms  p95_ms  tok/s  $/1Mtok (rel)
small-chat  A10G  24      80      150k  1.00
small-chat  L4    38      120     110k  0.72
small-chat  T4    46      210      90k  0.45
embeddings  A10G  16      60      200k  1.00
embeddings  L4    22      90      260k  0.65
embeddings  T4    30      150     180k  0.40
```
Numbers are medians across 30 runs per region, q4_0 quant for L4/T4 where supported, fp16 for A10G. Cost model uses on-demand price + perf; includes tokenization overhead.
Samir: surprising L4 throughput for embeddings — likely kernel optimized for matmul/kv cache.
Alex Kim: yup, L4's fused-kv kernel + quantization helps embeddings. T4 suffers on long contexts -> p95 spikes.
Lena H: region differences?
Alex Kim: per-region notes:
- us-west: A10G p95 stable, L4 good if you enable prefix cache and batching (batch 8-16). Spot A10G sometimes gives better unit-cost but higher variance.
- eu-north: T4 price advantage but tail issues at scale; consider dedicated for >1000 qps.
- ap-south: network tail adds ~5-10ms; prefer L4 for embeddings (cost+throughput), A10G for latency-sensitive chat.
Maria V: what about quantization knobs? q4_0 vs int8?
Cheng Wu: we tried q4_0 on L4/T4: quality delta on small-chat BLEU-like metrics ~0.5% vs fp16, embeddings cosine drop <0.3%. int8 gave slightly higher regressions on chat.
Alex Kim: recommendation: L4/T4 -> q4_0 for embeddings, q4_0 or q8_0 for small-chat with conservative eval sets. A10G -> fp16 preferred for chat at low latency.
Samir: any kernel fallbacks observed?
Alex Kim: yes — when sequence length >4096 and batch>8 some nodes fell back to generic attention (cuBLAS path) causing 2-3x latency. We added service guard to route >4k to A10G.
Lena H: do we have an autoscale recipe?
Alex Kim: compact autoscale snippet we used:
```
policy:
  target_latency_p95: 120ms
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 50
  scale_metric: qps_per_gpu
  batch_hint: 8
  cache_prefix: true
```
Use this for L4 pools for embeddings; for chat set target_latency_p95 80ms and prefer A10G fallback.

deploy-bot: rolling canary queued for saas-dedicated with L4 q4_0 profile
Maria V: any quality regression flags from evals?
Cheng Wu: one small-chat prompt category (long dialog with system prompts) showed 2% drop with q4_0 on T4 — flagged and linked to eval set id eval-2026-03-14-03.
Alex Kim: mitigation: increase decoding temperature clamp and enable conservative beam penalties for affected prompts; re-run regression test.
Samir: what's the suggested defaults for product teams?
Alex Kim: defaults:
- embeddings: L4 + q4_0, batch=16, prefix_cache=true
- small-chat latency-critical: A10G + fp16, batch=1-4, KV cache enabled
- small-chat cost-sensitive / dev: T4 + q4_0, batch=4, dedicate for low-qps dev namespaces
Lena H: any follow-ups we should track?
Alex Kim: action items:
1) @Cheng run regression re-check with beam penalties (due +24h)
2) @Maria finalize autoscale presets for L4 pools in us-west/eu-north (due +48h)
3) perf-bot to publish summary CSV in #eng-ml pinned (done)
Maria V: I'll do autoscale presets, will send PR to infra repo.
Cheng Wu: starting re-check now, will post logs.
Alex Kim: thanks all. I'll add condensed runbook to the internal runbooks page once PR lands. :thumbsup:
